name: The Mystic Land 2 MMORPG [ Team Raid Boss ]
desc:
The Mystic Land 2 is an Open-World MMORPG on Roblox, with Tab-Targeting Combat System (similar as World of Warcraft / Runescape) 
Choose your class and path. Defeat enemies to grind loot and gear up. Trade your loots with other players. Challenge powerful Bosses, Raids and monsters.

+={===>
✨ 7 Classes and 15 job paths available, with 20 save slots! 
✨ Reaching Level 51: Complete 2nd Job quest to choose your path. 
✨ Reaching Level 101: Complete 3rd Job quest to further learn more skills.
✨ Figure out optimal builds, Stack max stats, upgrade your gear (+15 or up) and watch your DPS skyrocketing! 

+={===>
💪Traditional RPG experience with 'Hot Bar' / 'Action Bar'.
🗺️Multiple regions to explore 
💥Challenging Bosses and Dungeon Raid with juicy loots.
🤝Player-driven economy: Trading with others

► Latest Update Info: 
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/tml2log/3485419
Weekly update! More updates and contents coming!
